teaser: The spare key rides in your pocket, in case the night goes somewhere else. Life path 5 asks for motion and variety, and an ESFP walks in already built for both. Where another number might have to talk itself into leaving the house, you were halfway out the door before the question finished. The particular thing about this crossing is how little resistance there is: nothing in you argues with the appetite for change, so the appetite rarely slows down long enough to be examined. A full week without a new face in it can start to feel like the walls are closing, long before anyone else at the table notices.
